_comment: Comprehensive Chrome-heavy + Google-apps battery. device: 'emulator' (runs on emulator, no account/data needed), 'real' (needs real phone + signed-in account/data), 'both'. Navigation-first (reach the screen); non-destructive (no send-to-others/pay/delete). English (Caddie English-first; agent navigates German Pixel UI fine from English intent).
